name: @atlasbound/handoff
description: One note per branch that lets a fresh session continue: built from measured facts, with the person's own decisions and jobs kept.

verbs.what: rebuild this branch's note from measured facts, then show it with this session's messages and the fill-in

help.line: rebuild this branch's handoff note and show it, for your AI to fill in
help.when: at the end of a session: the /handoff command runs it
help.changes: the branch's note in ~/.atlasbound (your home, never the repository)

flags.--session <id>: the AI session whose messages the note shows

verbs.what: --file <draft in .atlasbound/drafts/> (removed once kept), or the JSON on standard input: write now, next and the kept lines into the note; a kept line names the message it comes from

help.line: save the note your AI filled in: where you are, the next step, the lines to keep
help.when: right after atlasbound handoff, as /handoff says

flags.--session <id>: the AI session the note is for
flags.--file <path>: read the reply from this draft in .atlasbound/drafts/, then remove it

verbs.what: show this branch's handoff note as saved, how old it is, and whether the branch moved since

help.when: to read the note yourself; /resume-handoff gives it to a new AI session

verbs.what: <n> [new words]: drop kept line n of the note, or reword it when new words follow; you type its phrase at your own terminal

help.when: when a kept line is wrong or no longer matters

verbs.what: why each kept line is there, what was dropped, the note's HEAD against the live one, what was not measured, the context notice

help.line: say why each line of the handoff note is there and what was left out
help.when: when the note says something you did not expect

flags.--session <id>: the AI session to look at
